tasks.short: Sample melt and calculate material requirements

steps.what: Draw identified smelted metal samples from the furnace for analysis
Check returned analysis and capture the approved material calculation inputs
Calculate candidate material amounts using the approved formula and checked inputs
Assess candidate types and amounts against melt conditions and specifications

tasks.design: Keep sampling and material judgement human, and configure only approved arithmetic in {SPREADSHEET}. The workbook returns a candidate quantity without controlling the furnace or selecting a material on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated arithmetic may sit between a checked laboratory result and a material requirement decision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas can repeat an approved calculation without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Determine whether the sample and assumed material behaviour represent the current melt.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when the numerical answer is not operationally appropriate.

reach.task: Trace a material calculation to a sample
reach.learn: Check sample identity and units before comparing results

evidence.claim: Approved material arithmetic can be implemented in a workbook, but this furnace calculation scenario and labour effect are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: The operator produces sample identity in s1. After s1 the laboratory technician performs the existing analysis and returns sample identifier, measured composition, units and result time; laboratory work is unchanged and no laboratory saving is claimed.

In s2 the operator verifies and captures sample linkage, measured composition, charge mass, target specification, candidate material composition and applicable approved factors. All transcription and clarification are included in 20 hours.
The established process engineering method supplies the formula and its applicability limits before use; added method review is charged below.
Missing results, uncertain factors or out of range inputs stop calculation and return to manual assessment in s4.
Native workbook functions come first. Physical additions and furnace control are outside this calculation proposal.
unknowns: Existing calculation support and approved factors
research_questions: Is there repeat arithmetic left to remove after input verification and assessment?

already_counted.description: Sampling, result and field verification, material judgement

incremental.description: Process engineering method and factor review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=85 yields 15 gross and 7 net after 8 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-2 reflects dominant sampling and judgement and possible existing calculation support.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture production context and verify source readings before compiling the log
Assemble production logs from checked fields and available controller exports
Reconcile production totals, correct missing context and approve the completed log

tasks.design: Configure a native production record form and controller import in the manufacturing system category represented by {OPS_SYSTEM}. The operator captures context and approves the completed log after reconciliation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Numbers were recopied from instruments and notes into recurring production logs.
tasks.enabler_now: Manufacturing record modules can collect controller data and manual entries together.
tasks.still_hard: Explain missing readings and distinguish a process issue from a record issue.
tasks.human_edge: Connect the logged numbers to what actually happened at the furnace.
tasks.altitude: Own production data quality and exception closure.

reach.learn: Check source identity and missing context

evidence.claim: MPDV HYDRA X collects quantities and machine statuses from controller data or manual entries.
Furnace log mapping and proposed labour savings are an unmeasured task scenario.

assumptions: The controller produces tagged readings through its existing operation. In s1 the operator verifies furnace, heat identifier, order, time range and units and captures quantities absent from the controller, stop reasons and explanatory notes. All manual capture and correction are counted in 30 hours.
No discrepancy or reason code is inferred. The operator chooses it from observation; unavailable context remains unresolved until s3.
Native forms and import are tried first; missing or incompatible controller fields use manual capture in s1 and s3.
Only recording time changes; tending, measurement and furnace control receive no savings here.
unknowns: Available controller tags and existing record automation
research_questions: How much recording time is removed after context capture and reconciliation?

already_counted.description: Manual context capture, source checks and final reconciliation

incremental.description: Tag mapping upkeep and sampled log reconciliation

approvals.approved_version: Exact log version, heat, readings, quantities and explanations; edits invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=55 gives 45 gross and 38 net after 7 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-12 allows manual-only readings and existing native logging; physical operation is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe furnace conditions and adjust controls

steps.what: Observe gauges, metal color and fluidity and adjust controls to maintain required temperatures

tasks.design: Keep furnace observation and adjustment with the operator using existing equipment. A reporting dashboard is not credited with replacing this physical control task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe adjustment depends on the actual melt and equipment response.
tasks.enabler_now: No supplied evidence establishes removal of operator observation and control.
tasks.still_hard: Combine instrument readings with visual and process cues.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise conditions that call for stopping or escalation.

reach.learn: Distinguish measured readings from process interpretation

evidence.claim: The digest covers production records rather than replacement of furnace tending; no task labour saving is established.

assumptions: The operator observes and interprets readings during s1; there is no free structured temperature suitability flag.
Existing control machinery remains in the baseline and earns no new saving.
No added deployment means incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Furnace control arrangement and local operating limits
research_questions: Which observed conditions most often require escalation?

incremental.description: No changed system or operating process

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: all furnace observation and adjustment remains, with zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Kindle fires and load materials into furnaces using manual handling, hoists or crane signals

tasks.design: Retain ignition, physical loading and crane coordination with the workers performing them. No software saving is assigned to existing hoists or conveyors.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task physically moves materials and starts the furnace.
tasks.enabler_now: No task replacement is established by the supplied record keeping evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Coordinate safe movement around hot equipment.
tasks.human_edge: Respond to actual load movement and nearby workers.
tasks.altitude: Strengthen loading coordination and operating discipline.

reach.learn: Recognise safe movement and communication boundaries

evidence.claim: Digital production records do not perform ignition or physical furnace loading; no labour saving is established.

assumptions: Load checks and crane communication remain in s1, with no structured ready to load flag assumed.
The same physical work is retained; no labour is shifted to an uncounted equipment operator.
No new system is introduced, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Handling methods used for each furnace
research_questions: Which loading handovers create avoidable uncertainty?

incremental.description: No added deployment or operating work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: physical ignition and loading remain fully counted, giving zero gross and net savings.

role.altitude: Improve calculation and record traceability while retaining physical furnace operation.
reach: Help supervisors reconcile production logs and sample references
role.ambitious_version: An operator with less repeated log entry and preserved attention for melt conditions and material handling.
